messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: stat_summary question
parts:
I'm not sure what the issue here is. Am I missing something? The following does not generate a line connecting the means for each level of x, as I would expect (right or wrong). Any ideas? Thanks.

tst.data <- data.frame (x = c(rep("Blue",500), rep("Red",500)), y =c(rnorm(500,3,6), rnorm(500,8,4) ) )
ggplot ( data = tst.data,aes(x,y)) + geom_point(alpha = .3) + stat_summary(fun.y = "mean",geom = "line")




Adam Loveland

messages.subject: Re: stat_summary question
parts:
hi,

geom_line connects data points of the same group, so try this:

ggplot ( data = tst.data,aes(x,y, group=1)) + geom_point(alpha = .3) +
stat_summary(fun.y = "mean",geom = "line")

--

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: follow-up to stat_summary question (labelling summary statistic)
parts:
Was having trouble labelling the mean that's calculated using stat_summary. Taking initial example (now with group added; thanks Kohske),

tst.data <- data.frame (x = c(rep("Blue",500), rep("Red",500)), y=c(rnorm(500,3,6), rnorm(500,8,4) ) )
ggplot ( data = tst.data,aes(x,y)) + geom_point(alpha = .3) +

stat_summary(aes(group=1),fun.y = "mean",geom = "line")

Above works.

tst.data <- data.frame (x = c(rep("Blue",500), rep("Red",500)), y=c(rnorm(500,3,6), rnorm(500,8,4) ) )
ggplot ( data = tst.data,aes(x,y)) + geom_point(alpha = .3) +

stat_summary(aes(group=1),fun.y = "mean",geom = "line") +
stat_summary(aes(group=1),fun.y = "mean",geom = "text")

This doesn't. It asks for the label, but I'm not sure how to add it (adding it as I would a usual aesthetic doesn't work). And of course, once I add it, I'd like to be able to format it somehow (e.g. dollar).

Thanks again.



Adam Loveland
